classes.name: StringStore
classes.description: Manages retrieval and decoding of localized strings, supporting base64 decoding and unzip operations to extract text for report display.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: Encapsulates statistical summary data for test execution, including total, pass, fail, and skip counts.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Constructs a Message object with specified level, timestamp, message text, and additional info.

methods.name: parseStatus
methods.description: Converts a status code to a human-readable status string.

methods.name: childCreator
methods.description: Generates a function that creates and adds child elements of a specific type to a parent component.

methods.name: createBodyItem
methods.description: Creates a message or keyword element based on the input data, used for rendering report entries.

methods.name: createKeyword
methods.description: Creates a Keyword object representing a keyword element within a test or suite, assigned with status and lazy-loaded details.

methods.name: lazyPopulateKeywordsFromFile
methods.description: Sets up lazy loading for keywords, either immediately or from a split log file, to optimize performance.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Maps a list of tag identifiers to their string representations.

methods.name: createTest
methods.description: Creates a Test object with its associated metadata, status, tags, and potentially lazy-loaded keywords.

methods.name: createSuite
methods.description: Builds a Suite object with metadata, status, child suites, tests, and associated keywords, supporting nested suites.

methods.name: parseMetadata
methods.description: Converts raw metadata array into structured key-value pairs with localized strings.

methods.name: suiteStats
methods.description: Creates a summary object of suite statistics, including total, pass, fail, and skip counts.

methods.name: Populator
methods.description: Helper to manage the creation of multiple child items (keywords, tests, suites) from array data with associated strings.

methods.name: SplitLogPopulator
methods.description: Handles lazy population of items from split log files, supporting large datasets efficiently.

methods.name: suite
methods.description: Initializes and returns the root suite structure from embedded window.output data.

methods.name: findLoaded
methods.description: Retrieves a loaded suite or test element by its id.

methods.name: ensureLoaded
methods.description: Ensures suite or test data are loaded, especially from split logs, invoking callback afterward.

methods.name: loadItems
methods.description: Recursively loads nested suite or test items based on id segments.

methods.name: selectFrom
methods.description: Selects a specific child element (keyword, test, suite) from a parent based on type and index.

methods.name: errorIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over recorded errors for report display.

methods.name: statistics
methods.description: Returns an object encapsulating overall test run statistics.

methods.name: StringStore
methods.description: Stores and fetches localized strings, decoding base64 and unzipping when necessary.
